quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung Electro-Mechanics press release: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Signs KRW 360.5 Billion Long-Term (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Long-term supply agreements: the KRW 360.5 billion long-term supply agreement is a one-year supply of high-performance memory semiconductor package substrates to a global major customer (01-01-2027 to 12-31-2027), a large-scale order for the Package Solution Unit following the Component Solution Unit's long-term supply agreements for silicon capacitors, MLCCs for AI servers and high-performance inductors since May. Long-term supply agreements signed since May 2026 now total seven based on public disclosures (2.5% or more of sales), with a cumulative contract amount of KRW 4.3 trillion. The company plans to expand long-term supply agreements with major customers to overcome business-cycle volatility and move toward a stable, high-profit business structure.
quarterly_data.figure: seven long-term supply agreements since May 2026, cumulative KRW 4.3 trillion; memory package substrates KRW 360.5 billion for 2027
